coordinate_policy: Preserve every source row and raw coordinate. Derive geometry/H3 only for non-NULL finite WGS84 coordinates within longitude [-180,180], latitude [-90,90]. Preserve valid (0,0) and locations outside NYC; do not impute, snap, repeat, or discard rows.
subset_policy: Diagnostic prefix in original archive row order. The full scale retains every archive record, including any out-of-month timestamps. source_id is csv:<1-based original row ordinal>, not an upstream trip identifier.

airport.name: JFK Airport
airport.derivation: GDAL 3.13.1 ogr2ogr EPSG:2263 to EPSG:4326; all four polygon components retained, no simplification or densification. This is the pinned 2026 boundary applied to 2015 pickups, not a claim about historical 2015 boundaries.

qualification: Real-data characterization only. Not the full-year NYC corpus, an official benchmark score, CUDA qualification, or a release performance claim.

archive.provenance: Original-format monthly CSV mirrored by Inria Aviz, last modified 2023-12-06; not the similarly named cleaned file or modern zone-ID Parquet. Mirror bytes are pinned independently; not claimed byte-identical to the current NYC Open Data export.
